summary: Shared change (bot AI code, tests and BOT_LOGIC.md): bot defense guidance. When the attacker assigns no infantry but has unbowed Cavalry at home, the bot weighs its Force against the attacker's total possible Cavalry army (+0.1 per hand card and printed Battle action until 1), commits infantry to the most valuable province, adds an army per further sub-army that reaches 1, and keeps leftovers home unless they print a Battle action. Behind BotContext.UseCavalryDefense (on by default). No engine, wire or UI change.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed, including new cavalry-defense planner and bot decision tests and the bot soak. Not measured in the bot arena.
remaining: Interpretations to confirm: ratio read as defender/attacker (confirmed by Mendon); 'most valuable province' ranks face-up Personalities by Gold cost without an affordability check; applies only to the infantry defense step with no attackers assigned; arena measurement not run.
